value.body: Public-sector companies need company secretaries to run board and shareholder meetings, statutory filings, corporate governance and compliance with the Companies Act, SEBI rules for listed PSUs, and government guidelines. Posts range from Assistant Manager (Company Secretariat) to Company Secretary.

items.label: When a whole-time CS is mandatory
items.value: Listed companies and public companies with paid-up capital ≥ ₹10 crore
items.source: Companies Act, 2013, Section 203 and related Rules

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India, with post-qualification experience for higher grades. PSUs advertise on their own websites; selection is usually shortlisting, a written test and/or interview, under each company's age and experience rules.

value.title: At a glance
items: Openings are few — usually one person or a small team per company.
Experienced-level posts are more common than fresher posts.
Postings are usually at the corporate or registered office.
